camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListHostsForUser --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --PageNumber 1 --UserId 1 --OSType Linux --Mode Authorized --ProjectId 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostAddress '192.168.XX.XX' --HostName abc
description_en: Queries the hosts that a user group is authorized or not authorized to manage
description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机用户已授权或未授权的主机列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-hosts-for-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode Authorized --user-id 1 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --host-address 192.168.XX.XX --host-name abc --os-type Linux --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHostsForUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query the hosts that the user is authorized or not authorized to manage.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户所在堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to query the hosts that the user is authorized or not authorized to manage.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the category of the hosts that you want to query. Valid values:

Authorized: queries the hosts that the user is authorized to manage. This is the default value.

Unauthorized: queries the hosts that the user is not authorized to manage
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机列表的模式。取值：
Authorized：已授权（默认）
Unauthorized：未授权
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the ID of the user
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the host that you want to query. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机地址，可使用域名或IP地址。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en: The name of the host that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的主机名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en:

Linux

Windows
